dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: Two distinct, high-contrast white horizontal bands visible across the median and greater coverts.
dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Sharp, thin pale gray margins visible along the outer edges of the folded primary and secondary feathers.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: A clear, linear transition from the solid dark gray of the crown/nape to the white-patterned mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced white chevron-like V-patterns repeating across the scapulars and mantle feathers.
